amendment_20261101_r2.cycle: Wave 1 repair, cycle 1 of at most 2 for this releasing family (the round-4 plan, rules for the round)
amendment_20261101_r2.base: b840ae756 (the integrated Wave 1 head); every movement below is against it unless it says installed
amendment_20261101_r2.why: An independent refutation of b840ae756 (findings F6, CTS-3 and CTS-4) found three defects in the one-cause rule. F6: a line that itself names an earlier occurrence ("What the Earlier Echoendoscope Showed", under Prior Studies) counted as an unread heading, so a correct exclusion of an earlier EUS (43259) became a hold. CTS-3: any short title-case line inside a history section counted - a surgical-history entry ("Colonoscopy With Biopsy" above "Upper Endoscopy With Dilation"), a provider line ("Alan Synthetic MD"), a page line ("Page 2 of 3"), a procedure-name line or a facility line opening a Prior Procedures entry - so correct exclusions (43249, 43276) became holds, and the held EGD made a READY office visit (99214) a possibly-same-day hold. CTS-4: on the act path (_agreed_not_done) the one-cause explanation was discarded, so the hold of the h4-05 counterfactual showed the inventory's act_missing words, which are false of h4-05 ("no endosonographic examination is documented as done in it"; h4-05 states the echoendoscopic views). Each was reproduced on a sealed export of b840ae756 before this amendment.

rule_changed.real unread heading (F6, CTS-3): _section_only_routing_reading now needs _pa_unread_heading (engine.py) where it read sections.beyond_heading_reach: reading up from the passage to the section's heading line, the nearest heading-like line (the same heading-like test) that stands as a REAL heading - not the section's first line under its heading; not a page line ("Page 2 of 3"), a provider line (a credential at its end, an aside in brackets read past, or a title such as "Dr." before a name) or a facility line (hospital, medical center, clinic, university, institute, endoscopy center ...); not a bare procedure name (a service services.SERVICES names and nothing else but connectors, acts and qualifiers); bounded above (a blank line, a sentence's end or a field line); and followed by content (its next non-empty line, at most three lines down, is a sentence, a field, a bulleted or numbered item or a line longer than 60 characters). A line that is heading-like but no real heading is read past as the section's own content. Fail-closed as before: beyond 200 lines or 20,000 characters with nothing nearer deciding, it is one cause (_PA_FAR).
rule_changed.a line naming another occurrence governs: when the nearest heading-like line above the passage names another occurrence's record (sections.ANOTHER_OCCURRENCE_HEAD), the document's own words date the passage: not one cause, the agreement stands (the installed exclusion)
rule_changed.the act path says why (CTS-4): in engine._select, where the act path's agreement fails (found.reason act_missing, routing not_performed, no time in doubt) and _second_reading's reason is the one-cause one with no documented act of the code's kind in the passage (_acts_in_passage, factored out of _agreed_not_done unchanged), _pa_one_cause_hold replaces the match's words: reason readings_disagree (was act_missing), question "Confirm whether <code> was performed on the date of service.", detail "The routing-era reading of the passage it cites reads it as <status> only by its section: <cite>. The documented-service reader reads it the same only by its section: one cause, not two readings; <reach> (<clause>). Held for the reviewer, not excluded." The bucket and status are unchanged (held either way); any other disagreement keeps its words
rule_changed.the reach words quote the line: _pa_reach says "its section <heading> reaches it only past the line <the real heading line>, written as a heading, which the layout does not read as one" (was "... only past a line written as a heading that the layout does not read as one"); the far wording is unchanged
rule_changed.unchanged: sections.py (PS) and every reader, the request side, _held_unless_agreed's held reading, the other holds of _second_opinion and _not_the_same_not_done but for the reach words, version labels
